# Anders Møller Schlünsen

Anders Møller Schlünsen is an epidemiologist with a doctoral degree (Ph.d.) who serves as the clinical epidemiologist ("Klinisk epidemiolog") for [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]] (AFDK), a role documented in the database's annual reports [^src1][^src2]. He is affiliated with [[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]] (RKKP), the organization that runs Denmark's clinical quality databases [^src2].

Schlünsen appears in the AFDK annual report covering the period 1 July 2022 to 30 June 2023, in the section detailing the database's data foundation, patient-population definitions, data-collection limitations, and the composition of the steering group [^src1]. He is listed there as "Anders Møller Schlünsen, Epidemiolog, Ph.d., RKKP" [^src1]. He also appears in the subsequent report, in the section covering pages 66–70, which documents patient representatives' perspectives on structured patient education, describes how Hospitalsenhed Midt has run systematic patient education since 2012, and again lists the steering group's members along with key methodological limitations of the database [^src2]. That section underscores AFDK's role as a nationwide quality database operating under the Danish Society of Cardiology (Dansk Cardiologisk Selskab) and with the approval of the Danish Health Authority (Sundhedsstyrelsen) [^src2].

Across both reports, Schlünsen's role is consistent: he is named as the clinical epidemiologist supporting AFDK's steering group and data infrastructure, working within RKKP's institutional framework [^src1][^src2].
